articles.title: Wall Street’s tokenization boom has a liquidity problem: Axis CEO
articles.snippet: As RWAs cross $32 billion and JPMorgan files for a new tokenized fund, Axis CEO Chris Kim argues that the industry is celebrating the wrong milestone.

articles.title: Senators File Clarity Act Amendments on DeFi, Trump Family, and Jeffrey Epstein
articles.snippet: The Senate Banking Committee will vote tomorrow on the new additions to the crypto bill, before deciding whether to refer it to the Senate floor.

articles.title: JPMorgan Files to Launch Tokenized Money Market Fund on Ethereum
articles.snippet: Global banking giant JPMorgan filed for a new tokenized money market fund that will initially run on the Ethereum network.

articles.title: Fake OpenAI Repo Hit #1 on Hugging Face—And Stole Passwords While It Trended
articles.snippet: A lookalike repository impersonating OpenAI's Privacy Filter model racked up 244,000 downloads in under 18 hours before Hugging Face pulled it.
